title: KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang: Bus, Train, Taxi Compared
metaDescription: KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang by bus to Lalaport BBCC or Pudu Sentral, KLIA Ekspres plus Monorail, or a fixed price taxi. Times, fares and late arrivals.

contentBlocks.content: No train or bus runs from KLIA2 straight into Bukit Bintang. You have four ways to get there. A bus to Lalaport BBCC ends at an indoor hub two Monorail stops from Bukit Bintang. A bus to Pudu Sentral ends one MRT stop away, and on Easybook it was listed from RM15. The KLIA Ekspres reaches KL Sentral in about 33 minutes for RM55, and the Monorail takes you on from there. A taxi or Grab takes 45 to 60 minutes and stops at your hotel door. Pick by three things: your luggage, the size of your group and the time you land.
Key Takeaways
Is there a direct bus from KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang? Not to Bukit Bintang itself. Airport buses go to Lalaport BBCC and to Pudu Sentral, and both are a short train ride from Bukit Bintang.
Which bus ends closest? The bus to Lalaport BBCC. It stops inside a mall in Bukit Bintang City Centre, next to the BBCC Hang Tuah station.
What does the train cost? RM55 per adult on the KLIA Ekspres to KL Sentral (KLIA Ekspres), plus a Monorail ticket to Bukit Bintang.
What if there are four of us with suitcases? Four train tickets come to RM220 before the Monorail. A fixed price taxi is one fare for the car and drops you at the hotel.

What if I land after 11 PM? Trains stop at every station from 11 PM and finish between midnight and 1 AM. The Lalaport hub is open 24 hours, so check bus times for your date. A booked taxi runs at any hour.

By bus to Lalaport BBCC: ends in Bukit Bintang

Lalaport BBCC is a mall in Bukit Bintang City Centre with a bus terminal underneath it. The Lalaport Transportation Hub opened in July 2026. It is on Level LG1 of the East Atrium and is open 24 hours (The Straits Times). You step off the bus indoors, with paid lockers, ATMs, money changers and food on the same floor.

From the hub, walk to BBCC Hang Tuah station, which serves the LRT and the KL Monorail. Ride the Monorail two stops, through Imbi, to Bukit Bintang station. If your hotel is close to the mall, check the walking route on your map app first; you may not need the train. Read the Lalaport Transportation Hub guide for the lockers, the lounge and the exits.
Booked a Teeko travel SIM? You can collect it at the tour centre at KLIA2 before you board, or at the tour centre at Lalaport BBCC when you arrive. The exact counter details come with your booking.

contentBlocks.content: By bus to Pudu Sentral: one MRT stop away

Pudu Sentral is the city bus terminal on Jalan Pudu, within walking distance of Chinatown and Petaling Street. On ttklia.com it is listed as KL City Centre (Pudu Sentral). On Easybook on 11 October 2026, Starmart Express ran the route from RM15, with the first bus at 7:15 AM, the last at 10:15 PM and a journey of about 1 hour 10 minutes. Times change, so check them for your date when you book.

Pudu Sentral connects on foot to Plaza Rakyat LRT and Merdeka MRT stations. Walk to Merdeka, then ride the MRT Kajang line one stop to Pavilion Kuala Lumpur Bukit Bintang station. Follow the signs for Pavilion when you come up.

contentBlocks.content: By train: KLIA Ekspres and the Monorail

The KLIA Ekspres runs from KLIA2 to KL Sentral in about 33 minutes, every 20 minutes, from 4:55 AM (KLIA Ekspres). A single ticket is RM55 for adults and RM25 for children aged 6 to 15. Buy at the counters or machines on Level 2 of Gateway@klia2, or online for 10% off, then go down one level to the platforms.

At KL Sentral, follow the signs to the Monorail station in the NU Sentral mall across the road. Ride five stops, through Hang Tuah and Imbi, to Bukit Bintang station. You can also walk the 850 metre walkway to Muzium Negara MRT station and ride three stops to Pavilion Kuala Lumpur Bukit Bintang.
With two big suitcases, the change at KL Sentral is the hard part, so think about a taxi instead. The KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide covers the train and the airport bus to KL Sentral in more detail.
By taxi or Grab: door to door

A taxi or Grab from KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang takes 45 to 60 minutes, depending on traffic. Grab fares change with demand, so the price at 2 AM can be very different from the price at noon. Grab pickup is at the Transportation Hub on the LG floor; follow the ride hailing signs.

To know the price before you fly, book a fixed price taxi. ttklia.com sells KLIA2 taxi transfers to Bukit Bintang and Bangsar by sedan, MPV or van, with no meter and no surge pricing. Your driver tracks your flight and waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board. For four adults, compare that one fare with RM220 in train tickets. See the KLIA2 airport taxi guide for how the counters work.

contentBlocks.content: Landing late at KLIA2

From 11 PM, KLIA Ekspres trains stop at every station, and the last trains leave the airport between midnight and 1 AM. On the Easybook listing, the last Pudu Sentral bus left at 10:15 PM. The Lalaport hub is open all night, but each bus runs to its own timetable, so check departures for your date on ttklia.com. A booked taxi runs at any hour.
Too tired to ride into the city at 3 AM? Read staying at KLIA2 or riding in late before you decide.
Landing at KLIA Terminal 1?
The KLIA Ekspres also stops at KLIA Terminal 1, so the train route above works from there too. The buses in this guide leave from KLIA2. See KLIA to KLIA2 transfer for how to move between terminals.
Hungry when you get there?

Bukit Bintang has food for every budget, from Jalan Alor at night to the Japanese floor of Lot 10. Start with the Bukit Bintang food guide, then plan your days with things to do in Bukit Bintang. Flying out later? The Bukit Bintang to KLIA2 guide covers the trip back.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is there a direct bus from KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang?

No bus from KLIA2 stops in Bukit Bintang itself. The bus from KLIA2 to Lalaport BBCC ends two Monorail stops away, and the bus to Pudu Sentral ends one MRT stop away. Both leave from the Transportation Hub on Level 1.
How long does it take from KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang?

KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang takes 45 to 60 minutes by taxi or Grab. By train it is about 33 minutes to KL Sentral plus the Monorail. The bus to Pudu Sentral was listed at about 1 hour 10 minutes, plus one MRT stop.
How do I get from Lalaport BBCC to Bukit Bintang?
From Lalaport BBCC to Bukit Bintang, walk to BBCC Hang Tuah station and take the Monorail two stops, through Imbi, to Bukit Bintang station.
Can I get from KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang after midnight?

Yes. You can get from KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang after midnight by fixed price taxi or Grab, and some buses to the 24 hour Lalaport hub run late. Check bus times for your date on ttklia.com. The last trains leave between midnight and 1 AM.
Where do I catch the bus at KLIA2?
You catch the bus at the KLIA2 Transportation Hub on Level 1. After customs, follow the "Bus Station" signs from Level 2 and take the escalator down. The KLIA2 bus station guide shows the walk.
Conclusion

For KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang, take the bus to Lalaport BBCC if you want to end inside Bukit Bintang, the bus to Pudu Sentral if your hotel is near Chinatown or Pavilion, the KLIA Ekspres if you are in a hurry before 11 PM, and a fixed price taxi if you have a family, heavy bags or a late flight. Book your KLIA2 to Lalaport BBCC bus on ttklia.com before you fly.
